headline: Google adds AI chat sidebar to its search homepage
summary: Google redesigned its search homepage to add a collapsible sidebar for viewing and continuing AI chats, part of a wider push to make AI tools easier to reach from the search page. The redesign also removes the traditional search button.

claims.statement: Google redesigned its search homepage to add a sidebar for AI chat history.

sources.quote: Google is putting AI chats right on the homepage
Google rolls out new search homepage with AI chat history and no search button

claims.statement: The sidebar lets users view and continue previous AI chats.

sources.quote: open a collapsible sidebar to view and continue your AI chats

claims.statement: The redesigned homepage removes the traditional search button.
